Card Q&A.a:
Yes, it activates. This card's "this Digimon gains all effects of [Goldramon] in this Digimon's digivolution cards"  effect is an [All Turns] effect, so it will activate as soon as the digivolution is confirmed. Therefore, [When Evolving] effects are gained and will trigger.

Card Q&A.q: This card digivolved from [BT14-018 Goldramon]. This Digimon gains all effects of [Goldramon] in digivolution cards, but does [BT14-018 Goldramon]'s [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect activate?

Card Q&A.a:
Yes, you can. If this card's [All Turns] effect is used to gain a [When Digivolving] effect, this card's [When Digivolving] effect and the [When Digivolving] effect gained from the [All Turns] effect will trigger simultaneously upon the digivolution timing, therefore you may choose the activation order.

This Digimon gains all effects of [Goldramon] in digivolution cards, but after [EX3-035 Goldramon]'s [When Digivolving] effect activates and I return [EX3-069 Trial of the Four Great Dragons] from the trash to the hand, can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to use [EX3-069 Trial of the Four Great Dragons] from my hand?

Effect: [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] You may use 1 [God Flame] or 1 Option card with the [Four Great Dragons] trait from your hand without paying the cost.
[All Turns] This Digimon gains all effects of [Goldramon] in this Digimon's digivolution cards.
